definitions.explanation: Used alone as a casual all-purpose greeting or expression of thanks. Which one it means depends entirely on the situation.
Used to emphasize an apology or greeting.

examples.japanese: どうも⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
どうも⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
どうも⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧。
どうも、⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧！
どうも、⟦{助|たす}かりました→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
どうも、⟦お{待|ま}たせしました→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
どうも、⟦お{世話|せわ}になりました→お世話になる：25410_osewaninaru⟧。
どうも⟦うまくいかない→上手くいく：21787_umakuiku⟧。
どうも⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ようだ→ようだ：26593_youda⟧。

notes:
どうも is a versatile word with three distinct functions: casual greeting/thanks, emphasis, and expressing vague uncertainty.

AS GREETING/THANKS (casual):
Used alone, どうも serves as a casual all-purpose greeting or thanks. It can mean "hi," "thanks," or "sorry" depending on context.
- どうも！: Hi! / Thanks!
- どうも、⟦{助|たす}かりました→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧: Thanks, that helped.

AS EMPHASIZER:
Strengthens apologies, thanks, and greetings:
- どうも⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧: thank you very much
- どうも⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧: I'm very sorry
- どうも⟦{失礼|しつれい}しました→失礼する：15203_shitsureisuru⟧: I'm very sorry for being rude

AS UNCERTAINTY MARKER:
Expresses a vague feeling or impression — "somehow," "for some reason":
- どうも⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: something seems off
- どうも⟦うまくいかない→上手くいく：21787_umakuiku⟧: somehow it's not going well
- どうも⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{嘘|うそ}をついている→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧⟦ようだ→ようだ：26593_youda⟧: it seems like he's lying

WITH A NEGATIVE PREDICATE:
どうも〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ is a very common frame meaning "just can't (quite)" — the speaker is trying but not succeeding, and cannot say why:
- どうも⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧: I just can't remember
- どうも⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: I just can't accept it
This is the same uncertainty sense above, not a separate meaning.

REGISTER:
どうも alone as a greeting is casual. Combined with ⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧ or ⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧, it is appropriate in polite contexts.
